pw_slow_hash.note: PBKDF2-SHA256 with 310,000 iterations and a random 16-byte salt from secrets.token_bytes(16) (server.py:70).

token_csprng.note: Opaque random token from the secrets module. Only its SHA-256 hash is stored in the sessions table.

no_hardcoded_secret.note: The code has no signing key, secret, or literal fallback. Tokens are random and looked up in the database, so no key is needed.

token_expiry.evidence: server.py:147 "SELECT user_id FROM sessions WHERE token_hash = ?"
token_expiry.note: The session lookup never checks created_at and no other code expires sessions, so tokens work forever.

logout_revokes.note: Logout only clears the token in the browser. The server has no logout endpoint and never runs DELETE FROM sessions (routes at server.py:180-205).

owner_checks.evidence: server.py:313 "SELECT * FROM notes WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?"
owner_checks.note: Reading (server.py:321), updating (server.py:333 and 336), deleting (server.py:352 "DELETE FROM notes WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?") and sharing (server.py:364) all go through an owner check.

share_token_strong.note: 24 random bytes is 192 bits from a cryptographic RNG.

login_rate_limit.evidence: server.py:254-255 if not user or ... not check_password(...): return self.error_json(401, "Invalid email or password")
login_rate_limit.note: Failed logins are not counted, delayed, or locked out anywhere in the code.

sql_parameterized.evidence: server.py:252 "SELECT id, password_hash FROM users WHERE email = ?", (email,)
sql_parameterized.note: Every query uses ? placeholders. The only SQL without parameters is the fixed schema script (server.py:41) and the PRAGMA statements.

xss_safe_render.note: Note titles and bodies are set with textContent or input .value. The static files contain no innerHTML, outerHTML or insertAdjacentHTML.

security_headers.note: X-Content-Type-Options is only set on static files. The code never sets X-Frame-Options or Content-Security-Policy.
